entries.note: DPD China's first row: the shipper's data received in Shenzhen.
The label is printed; the parcel is not yet in DPD China's hands.
The first scan of the parcel at DPD China's Shenzhen depot.
The parcel is consolidated under the master air waybill the wording names, read as an ellipsis.
Export processing in China before the flight; no customs hold is stated.
Arrival at a transit hub of the DPD network on the way to the destination.
The destination's DPD unit receives the parcel at the depot that delivers it.

entries.wording: Information that the parcel is delivered successfully.
entries.note: The destination unit's delivery scan.
The recipient's signature for a delivery already scanned is on file. It follows the delivery and is not a second one, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: The signature or the runsheet completed has been received. POD available
entries.note: The proof of delivery reaches DPD China after the delivery; the tracker marks the row delivered. It is not a second delivery, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: Email notification has been sent successfully!
entries.note: A notice sent to the recipient. A notice, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
A notice sent to the recipient. A notice, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

The recipient asks the destination unit to leave the parcel at a safe place, which can come before the parcel leaves China. A choice, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
The recipient asks the destination unit to deliver to a pickup point, which can come before the parcel leaves China. A choice, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
The row's status, which the tracker shows as Info Received: the shipment's data received, waiting for the pickup or the drop-off. The adapter reads a row's status only when no scan has a stage.
The row's status: on the way to the destination. Read only when no scan has a stage.
The row's status: delivered. Read only when no scan has a stage.
The row's status: returned to the origin, to the overseas warehouse or picked up there by the sender, as the tracker's help says. Read only when no scan has a stage.
The row's status: a failed delivery, a customs hold, damage or loss, as the tracker's help says. Read only when no scan has a stage.
The status the tracker's filter gives a number it holds nothing under; the adapter reads the row's NotFound mark instead.
The row's status for a number the tracker holds nothing under, beside its NotFound mark; not a stage.
